consumer: An external graphing tool reading the exported snapshot JSON, asking 'what is the avatar's raw stored calorie value at this moment so I can plot calorie history over time?'
scope: The avatar's raw authoritative stored_kcal scalar (ground-truth world state), sampled over time
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar(scalars) — writes the engine getter results, including get_stored_kcal(), straight into the snapshot JSON
divergence: If kcal_percent (a normalized/computed proxy) were graphed instead of raw stored_kcal, a state where the healthy-kcal denominator shifts (e.g. a mutation/BMI change) moves the percent while raw stored_kcal is unchanged, misrepresenting the raw calorie history
